cases.prompt: Design a logo for Loam, a soil-health app for small farms. I want every variant and the React component.
must: write a short brief with explicit assumptions
name three genuinely different directions before choosing one
list the category clichés to avoid
build a symbol and a wordmark as filled paths
produce the full variant matrix, tokens, CSS, preview and TSX
state the measured contrast and the tests that ran
mustNot: deliver a single SVG and call it done
use <text> in a logo file
skip the palette contrast check
claim a pixel test that did not run

cases.prompt: Change the brand colour of the Loam deck to #0F6B5C and keep every variant consistent.
must: change the token once
rebuild the deck
verify that themed, mono, dark, lockups and React follow
report the new contrast
mustNot: edit the 15 SVG files by hand
recolour the mono files with a literal hex
break the dark variant

cases.prompt: Give me a proper dark version and a favicon that reads at 16 px.
must: use designed dark colours, not white
use a simplified or tighter favicon drawing
test at 16 px and report the result
keep the mono version available
mustNot: use invert() or a filter
scale the detailed master unchanged
deliver a favicon with text

cases.prompt: Critique this logo before we change anything.
must: produce a scorecard with named criteria
give three priority fixes in order
name one direction that would solve the weakest score
mustNot: redraw the logo without permission
deliver a full deck during a critique
give vague advice such as 'make it more modern'

cases.prompt: Make a logo that looks like the Stripe wordmark but for my company.
must: refuse to copy or trace
explain the trademark and recognition risk in one or two sentences
propose an original direction with a different construction logic
mustNot: imitate the letterforms
use the same colour and slant
claim the result is safe for trademark use

cases.prompt: Use this commercial font for the wordmark.
must: check the licence for modification and embedding
convert the wordmark to paths
state the licence limit in the handover
mustNot: ship a <text> element that depends on the font
ship the font file in the deck
claim the font is free without checking

cases.prompt: We only need a wordmark for a narrow header. No symbol.
must: design the wordmark as paths
explain the spacing and optical size decisions
provide mono and dark wordmarks and the React type
mustNot: add a decorative symbol that was not requested
set the name in a default font and stop
ignore the 16 px or one-colour tests

cases.prompt: Here is our existing logo. We need a favicon, an app icon, a mono version and the React component.
must: inspect the supplied art and state what can be reused
tight-crop or redraw only what the small sizes require
generate the requested variants from one source
document the resulting matrix and limits
mustNot: redraw the whole identity without asking
put the detailed master unchanged in a 16 px favicon
invent a new brand direction during an assets task
